cohort: 175 children aged 6-60 months, 97 with febrile seizure and 78 febrile controls
finding: Family history of epilepsy, cesarean delivery, family history of febrile seizure, and upper respiratory tract infection were identified as risk factors for febrile seizures in children.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to be a risk factor for febrile seizures in children.
